root_cause: closePlayer cancels the old metadata owner, then sets wantsPlayback=false and invokes cancelPendingSeek; its synchronous pbTick runs before resetMediaSource pauses/detaches the video and formerly admitted a new metadata owner using the post-close control generation. The late result therefore looked current and populated a successor page after close.
fix: Require the existing wantsPlayback intent both for automatic preparation admission and result ownership; cancel a now-stopped owner on progress ticks.
unit_tests: authored; deliberately deferred until batch adversarial review
startup_limit: Harness60s readiness timed out in capability probes under shared load; optional harness180s readiness only. No product deadline changed.
